title: Browser access (CORS)
unavailable: Policy unavailable — an admin token is required or the device does not support this setting.
openHint: Any site open in a browser on the same network can read the device's telemetry and history. Changing settings still requires the admin token.
allowlistHint: The device answers only apps served from the listed origins. Other sites in the browser get no data.
lockout: This window's origin ({origin}) is not listed — once access is closed it will lose its connection to the device. Add it before saving.
confirmText: Any site open in a browser on this network will be able to read the device's telemetry, history and economics. Use only on a trusted network or for debugging. Changing settings will still require the admin token.
builtin: always allowed — the RBgrid app at this address
emptyOwn: No origins of your own yet.
